name: What benefits can a criminal defense attorney expect from AEO?

mainEntity.name: What benefits can a criminal defense attorney expect from AEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: Criminal defense attorneys can expect several benefits from AEO. These include increased online visibility for relevant legal searches, higher-quality leads due to better targeting of client intent, improved ranking on AI-powered search engines and voice assistants, and a competitive edge in the crowded legal market. Ultimately, AEO aims to drive more consultations and client acquisitions by connecting your firm with individuals actively seeking legal representation.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO helps criminal defense attorneys gain increased online visibility, higher-quality leads, better rankings on AI search, and a competitive edge.
